Verdict: Needs changes before merge.

This PR changes toolpaths, confinement and crossing checks, and posted CL/G-code, so this is a SAFETY-tier review.
It also changes the UI in `crates/ui`.

## What looks good

- The `Method` parameter defaults to `Spiral`, keeps the stamp unchanged for `Spiral`, and writes the `0xA5` stamp byte only for `Adaptive` with `Trochoidal`.
- In `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_level.rs`, the code checks each cut against the level area and checks all moves from the start of the run across earlier moves.
- In `crates/motion/src/machining3d/troch.rs`, a bore starts on a plane only when `disc_clears` proves the disc is clear; otherwise it starts above the stock top.
- In `crates/motion/src/machining3d/ladder.rs`, a trochoidal run resets the cleared-plane state at every level so each level enters from the stock top.
- A refused level posts nothing, falls back to the Spiral plan, and records a note with the reason and Z height.
- Zero `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `build.rs`, `.github/`, `scripts/`, `.cargo/`, `rust-toolchain`, or `CHANGELOG.md` files changed in this PR.

## Requested before merge

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill3d_page.rs:13-28,112-120` and PR body: Add UI screenshots (before and after) to the PR body. Show the 3D Pocket Passes tab under `Adaptive` with the new `Method` combo and hint. Store screenshots only on the `pr-screenshots` branch of the fork and link them from the PR body. Do not commit screenshots or logs to the PR branch.
2. Update the branch against `upstream/main` after PR #2149 merges. The trial merge with `upstream/main` (`409c0b5abf6eb561a49349b31f83784f86b853d8`) failed with three conflicts inherited from #2149 (`PROJECT_VERSION = 72` vs upstream #2463):
   - `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:143-155`
   - `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs:537-543`
   - `crates/app/tests/sketch_project.rs:98-107`

## Results on PR head

Because the trial merge with `upstream/main` failed with conflicts, all checks ran locally on PR head `b94e2692f` with `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1` and without a GitHub runner.

- `xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` planned 684 steps (`review-2704^` planned 644 steps).
- `cargo test -j 12 -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` exited 0.
- `cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` exited 0.
- `cargo test -j 12 -p camcraft-motion --lib`: 442 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored.
- `cargo test -j 12 -p camcraft-motion` integration suites (`avoid_pocket` 3, `engagement_3d` 3, `machining3d` 23, `pocket3d_hsm` 3 + 1 ignored, `pocket3d_mask_edge` 6, `pocket3d_troch` 5, `trochoid_slot` 12): exited 0. Re-running `pocket3d_troch` after the M2 restore gave 5 passed, 0 failed in 28.58s.
- `cargo test -j 12 -p camcraft-sim --lib --test verify_avoid`: `sim lib` 190 passed, `verify_avoid` 5 passed.
- `cargo test -j 12 -p camcraft-app --lib --test pocket3d_trochoid`: `app lib` 379 passed + 1 ignored, `pocket3d_trochoid` 5 passed.
- `cargo test -j 12 -p camcraft-app` integration suites (`continuous_4axis_part` 9, `do_not_touch` 3, `golden_cl` 33, `mcp` 22, `operations` 120 + 6 ignored, `pocket3d_air_band` 4, `pocket3d_hsm` 1 + 2 ignored, `pocket3d_open_side` 7, `pocket3d_reach` 6, `project_roundtrip` 73, `sketch_project` 14): exited 0.
- `xtask gate batch` UI suites: `ui boundary` 3 passed, `ui boundary_picks` 7 passed, `ui operations` 31 passed, `ui shell` 21 passed, and `xtask gate test do_not_touch --crate ui` 2 passed.
- `xtask gate batch --only 'ui suites: lib'`: 1218 passed, 1 failed, 7 ignored. `diag::tests::diag_lines_are_tracing_events_at_their_level` panicked under `--test-threads=12` because a concurrent test logged `WARN` (`gpu: test adapter failed: no surface - trying the next adapter`). Running `xtask gate test diag_lines_are_tracing_events_at_their_level --crate ui --exact` alone passed (`ok in 0s`).

## Mutations and goldens

- M1 (`crates/motion/src/machining3d/troch.rs:128`): I bypassed `disc_clears(reg, c, rad)`. `machining3d::troch::tests::a_bore_starts_on_a_plane_only_where_its_disc_is_proved_cleared` failed (`left: -3.0, right: 2.0`), and it passed (`1 passed`) after I restored the code.
- M2 (`crates/motion/src/machining3d/ladder.rs:135-138`): I removed the reset of `prev_state` and `prev_passes` when `tr.on()`. `pocket3d_troch::a_fallback_level_under_a_fallback_level_still_enters_from_the_stock_top` failed (`the last level's descent starts over the stock top, not at Z -6.000`), and all 5 `pocket3d_troch` tests passed after I restored the code.
- M3 (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_level.rs:183`): I changed the slice scan to `*i >= n0 && *j >= n0`. `machining2d::adaptive_troch_level::tests::a_cut_across_an_earlier_move_is_refused_by_name` panicked at `adaptive_troch_level_tests.rs:48:5`, and it passed (`1 passed`) after I restored the code.
- Goldens: 0 moved goldens and 0 UI snapshot PNG changes. I read the 1 new golden `crates/app/tests/golden/pocket3d_trochoidal_pocket.cl` (1025 lines, 1023 moves) line by line. Level 1 (`Z=17mm`) bores from `Z=22mm` and cuts inside `[-14000, 14000] x [-5000, 5000]`. Level 2 (`Z=14mm`) bores from `Z=17mm`, cuts the same bounds, and retracts to `Z=25mm` and `Z=30mm`.

## Notes (not blocking)

- PR #2704 is stacked on draft PR #2149 (`39e6c84e8`), which carries `needs-rework`, `conflicts`, and `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` in `upstream/main...HEAD` (commit `b94e2692f` did not change that file). Merge #2149 first, then refresh this PR before final review.
- `crates/motion/src/machining3d/ladder.rs` grew from 434 lines on #2149 to 448 lines (over the 400-line limit, noted in the PR body).
- `pocket3d_troch::each_level_is_cleared_by_loops_inside_its_own_level_area` took 75.67s under parallel load (the standalone 5-test `pocket3d_troch` run finished in 28.58s).
- The PR body notes these unexercised paths: multi-level real parts, `Method = Trochoidal` with `Do not touch` items or app-level rest roughing, re-machining masks, posted `.nc` golden compares, engagement on stock left by upper levels, and non-Linux x86-64 platforms.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
